text:
Predicates:
Private(x) ::: x is a private university.
IvyLeague(x) ::: x is an Ivy League university.
ResearchUniversity(x) ::: x is a research university.
MovedTo(x, y) ::: x moved to location y.
Location(y) ::: y is a location.
YaleUniversity(y) ::: y is Yale University.

Premises:
YaleUniversity(y) ∧ Private(y) ∧ IvyLeague(y) ∧ ResearchUniversity(y) ::: Yale University is a private Ivy League research university.
MovedTo(y, newHaven) ::: Yale University moved to New Haven.

Conclusion:
Private(y) ∧ IvyLeague(y) ∧ ResearchUniversity(y) ∧ MovedTo(y, newHaven) ::: A private Ivy League research university moved to New Haven.
